sub_answers.text: Diana Fosha promotes therapeutic models that integrate relevant neurobiological processes including implicit memory and cognitive, emotional and sensorimotor processing [d72248675s19p0]. Ricky Greenwald applies eye movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR) and founded the Trauma Institute & Child Trauma Institute [d72248675s19p0]. Trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy (TF-CBT) and EMDR are listed as therapy models that utilize trauma-informed principles in clinical practice [d72248675s12p0]. The U.S. government's SAMHSA framework with the three E's and six key principles has been used as a trauma-informed approach in multiple settings [d72248675s3p0].

sub_answers.text: Anna Baranowsky developed the Traumatology Institute and addresses secondary trauma and effective PTSD techniques [d72248675s19p0]. SAMHSA provides an implementation framework including ten domains such as screening, assessment and treatment services, and training and workforce development that are used to structure trauma-related curricula and organizational policy [d72248675s3p0]. The Traumatology Institute and organizations like the National Child Traumatic Stress Network are among entities that support trauma-informed programs and trainings [d72248675s19p0][d72248675s19p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: What empirical studies, peer-reviewed articles, technical reports, case series, psychometric validations, meta-analyses, or monitoring-and-evaluation products did the psychologist produce concerning trauma in human-rights, conflict, or post-conflict settings — specify publication venues, study designs, sample characteristics, key findings, and dates?
sub_answers.text: Wilson and colleagues reviewed trauma-informed practices used in domestic violence contexts and organized principles into six clusters emphasizing safety, choice and control, and building healthy relationships [d72248675s13p0]. Researchers Kaitlin Casassa and colleagues conducted interviews with sex trafficking survivors to identify elements for breaking trauma bonds and facilitating healing [d72248675s3p0]. Debriefing as an early post-trauma intervention was evaluated historically and found to be ineffective or harmful, with studies showing increased PTSD rates leading to its discontinuation in some settings such as the US Department of Defense in 2002 [d41055635s2p0].

sub_answers.sub_question: In what ways did the psychologist operationalize trauma expertise within human-rights work — for example, by designing forensic psychological assessment protocols, contributing mental-health input to legal documentation, creating rehabilitation service pathways, training investigators on trauma-informed interviewing, or embedding screening tools into humanitarian programs; list concrete procedures, tools, partner agencies, and examples of cases or projects where these were used.
sub_answers.text: Trauma-informed design principles have been incorporated into prison architecture by HDR, Inc., and Lady Edwina Grosvenor promotes trauma-informed approaches in women's prisons in the United Kingdom [d72248675s12p0][d72248675s19p0]. Trauma- and violence-informed practices have been combined with interventions such as yoga, motivational interviewing, hospital-based violence intervention, and integration with primary physician care in sexual assault cases in domestic violence work [d72248675s13p0]. TIC principles have been operationalized across sectors through implementation domains including governance and leadership, policy, physical environment, engagement and involvement, cross sector collaboration, screening and assessment, training and workforce development, and progress monitoring [d72248675s3p0]. Multiple therapy models and programs operationalize TIC in practice including trauma systems therapy (utilizing EMDR), The Art of Yoga Project, the Wellness Recovery Action Plan, music therapy, and internet-based treatments for trauma survivors [d72248675s12p0].
